name: Minotaur Will
beast: Asterion the Minotaur of the Labyrinth

abilities.name: Ram Charge
abilities.effect: A short shoulder-first charge carrying the tamer forward and shoving anything in the way.

abilities.name: Maze Sense
abilities.effect: The bull's sense of the labyrinth: the nearest creatures (up to four) are outlined.

acquire.equipPiece: One bronze maze-patterned bracer on the right forearm (the only equipped piece); dust and impact lines behind the heels.

abilities.name: Rage of Asterion
abilities.effect: A blood-red rage: bonus damage and resistance for about 8 seconds, with a narrowed view.

abilities.name: Labrys Quake
abilities.effect: The labrys smashes the ground: stone ridges ring up to six foes and fling them up and in.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a bull beastman in bronze maze-plate: broad bull head with curved horns, flared nostrils with a gold ring, thick pauldrons, furred forearms with heavy clawed hands holding a labrys, digitigrade hoofed legs, a tufted tail and a stone-grey back ridge.

equip.weapon: A labrys double axe forged from the beast's horn-bronze.
equip.armor: Dark earth-brown bronze plate engraved with a maze pattern, thick pauldrons, a gold nose-ring visor.
equip.hair_eyes: Coarse dark mane down the neck; red-rimmed eyes.
equip.aura: Rising dust with a red rage haze.

beastNote: Asterion the Minotaur of the Labyrinth
lore: A bull-headed giant of the stone maze, enraged and untiring, who always finds the way to its prey.
pitch: Asterion the Minotaur is the bull-headed man-eater of the Cretan Labyrinth who always finds the way to his prey. Acquire keeps you human with one bronze maze bracer, lending a shoulder charge and a sense that outlines nearby creatures. Integrate makes you a hulking bull beastman in maze-engraved bronze plate with curved horns, hoofed legs and a labrys double axe, a melee brute whose rage and ground-quake cost a heavy strain and may hit allies if you are untrained.
untrained: An untrained holder is consumed by rage: strain surges with every charge, vision reddens and they hit allies and stone walls alike. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A hulking bipedal bull-beastman: broad horned bull head with flared nostrils, thick muscular shoulders, furred forearms and heavy clawed hands, digitigrade hoofed legs, a tufted tail, a gold nose-ring and a labrys double axe.
spirit.look: A dark earth-brown orb with a tiny maze pattern etched on its surface and two small gold horns curving around it.
